patch.value: Native core context intents and explicit section selection
Implement orient and handoff intent defaults, section selection, activity limits and budget receipts; certify deeper context and relationship packets against pm 2026.11.5.

JSON and TOON bytes, status and stderr match the oracle on generated non-git trackers and public tracker copies; retain typed calendar and memory refusals; focused tests fail on behavioral revert; record latency and differential counts.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Implemented core intent preparation, section selection, activity bounds and intent receipts. Current-oracle exploration identified three inherited context drifts: bounded activity excludes timestamps at or after the read clock; test health covers all matching active items and declares its scope; TOON auto-tables choose compact list/null columns only when shorter. Bringing these paths to the requested November contract before running the public-copy corpus.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Public-copy packet differential exposed the newer required-root-evidence-first-v1 ordering, reserved root-edge budget, root-edge priority and bounded-relationship omission receipt. Porting those native packet semantics as part of this slice, including updated producer fingerprints. No legacy packet result is being counted as current-oracle evidence.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Generated intent comparisons passed before the final expanded matrix. Public-copy exploration exposed the distinction between compact intent estimates and complete JSON wire ceilings, now handled by the shared output-budget path. Current dependency packets also require root-evidence-first ordering and revised refusal text; preserving the existing bounded retry test while eliminating repeated rendering of identical packets.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The expanded current-oracle corpus passed 306 intent/section/continuation comparisons. The broader suite passed 32 of 33 tests; the remaining debug retry timeout motivated sharing exact rendered-cost measurements across budget recovery probes. All library tests except the old ordering fingerprint fixture passed; that fixture is updated for the already-differentially-verified ordering. Added equal-sign option and token-budget alias refusal cases, plus lossless compact-table edge coverage. Strict Clippy and all 41 binary unit tests pass.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Behavioral revert proofs passed in a disposable text-source copy: disabling only intent preparation failed core_intent_boundaries_and_budget_receipts and context_intents_and_sections_match_current_oracle; disabling compact columns failed current_context_tables_keep_ambiguous_cells_lossless; restoring the prior packet implementation failed relationship_packets_match_oracle. Every run reached named test failures, with no compilation-only false positive. The package worktree stayed fixed; positive reruns follow.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The final expanded run exceeded its 30-minute linked-run timeout under shared-host oracle startup cost; it is not counted as a pass. Split the identical rich, empty and wide evidence matrices into independent tests, retaining every comparison while keeping the fixed two-worker ceiling. Increased the linked-run timeout to one hour. Each split test is included in the behavioral revert proof.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Behavioral revert validation passed for all five new tests: core intent unit, rich/empty/wide-wire integration fixtures, and lossless compact-table unit. The upgraded relationship packet differential also fails against the previous packet implementation. The scratch runner requires named assertion failures and rejects compilation-only failures. Clippy passed with all targets and features and warnings denied; the final positive differential run is underway.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Opened https://github.com/unbraind/pm-rust/pull/154 at 5b5f128 and immediately queued CodeRabbit using the required review queue. The PR distinguishes completed clippy, harness and six behavioral revert checks from the still-running generated differential suite and pending public-copy latency receipts. Full CI is now running independently.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The expanded positive run completed 34 of 35 tests successfully; its existing five-second debug-process guard failed under concurrent load for a low-budget dangling-reference packet. The isolated unchanged query returns the exact 496-token recovery receipt in about 0.8 seconds. Added query-local producer memoization with a two-MiB serialized retention ceiling, preserving every canonical recovery probe and the original timing guard. Separate oracle probes confirmed BOM/NEL normalization mismatches in intent, section and numeric controls; a shared ECMAScript trim domain and a 20-comparison regression matrix now cover them. Both fixes receive independent behavioral revert checks.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The first release-gate CI run exposed two legacy collection diagnostic differences: the context compaction predicate selected every item subcommand. Restricted that predicate to item deps, added a dedicated scope regression and its behavioral revert mutation, and included collection_commands_match_oracle in the focused rerun. The Unicode differential additionally exposed current human diagnostic control-character replacement; structured values remain unchanged while human context/dependency diagnostics preserve newline and replace control characters.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Current-oracle generated evidence now covers 342 rich/empty/wide intent and section comparisons plus 20 BOM/NEL controls and 128 distinct relationship comparisons. Five packet tests passed concurrently; the existing five-second resource guard passed all 12 cases in a serial rerun, retaining its threshold. Concurrent runs exceeded that wall-clock guard on this shared host, so they are not reported as full-suite passes. The linked whitespace regression passed. The collection diagnostic CI regression and final checks are still being verified.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: CodeRabbit round 1 completed with nine threads and two additional comments. Fixed the unstable revert baseline using a committed reverse patch; strengthened high-budget override, configured activity-limit and public TOON-rendering assertions. The reviewed malformed-timestamp case exposed a genuine native/oracle mismatch: activity now uses the published numeric comparison with lexical fallback, preserving older invalid timestamp data where the oracle retains it. Added an exact reviewed-contract matrix, an output-cursor published-CLI replay with explicit native refusal, and a tighter multi-edge cap fixture before deciding the remaining compatibility findings.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The reviewed-contract regression now passes 16 exact current-oracle comparisons, including receipt-only recovery replay. It exposed a second native defect: generic list receipt stabilization overwrote the omitted intent estimate and used JSON cost for TOON. Context now preserves the omitted-result estimate, measures the selected wire encoding, and retains explicit-section alias metadata. An independent behavioral revert mutation covers this correction. The regression also replays a real canonical output cursor through the published CLI and confirms the explicit native unsupported-option boundary.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: The expanded behavioral revert harness passed all 12 isolated mutation commands, producing 14 required assertion failures across 11 distinct tests, including every one of the nine new tests. This covers intent preparation, both compact-table and public renderer selection, configured activity caps, timestamp comparison, omitted-intent/wire receipt stabilization, ECMAScript control trimming, diagnostic scope, producer memoization and stored prior packet semantics. No compile-only failure was counted. Strict Clippy passes. The expanded multiple-edge reference matrix passes all 40 comparisons; current generated counts are 378 intent/section/control comparisons and 138 relationship comparisons across the focused successful runs.

value.author: codex-astra
value.text: Release-binary public-copy validation passed 271 exact comparisons: pm-vcs 99 (62 context, 37 relationships), pm-rl 101 (62, 39), pm-context 71 (60, 11). Together with 378 generated context and 138 generated relationship comparisons, this records 787 exact stdout/stderr/status comparisons. All authoritative copy hashes remained unchanged. The sanitized benchmark receipt records all samples, p50/p95 and the binary hash; five alternating fresh-process samples were measured per runtime and projection. Median native/oracle orient latency was 169.0/882.5 ms, 242.2/1471.0 ms and 97.5/1231.0 ms respectively. Formatting, strict Clippy, private-item rustdoc and release build passed; 398 library, 42 binary, 46 acceptance and 25 Node harness tests passed. The linked lookup run passed 34 tests and the linked Unicode differential passed. The 12-command revert run requires 14 assertion failures across all nine new tests and two upgraded existing tests. First-head CI collection diagnostics were fixed and the focused oracle regression passed. Round-1 review fixes and compatibility evidence are ready for the next push; final-head CI and review remain pending on PR 154.
